newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard April load factor falls.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard April load factor falls.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said Wednesday its April passenger load factor was 57.78 percent, down from 70.21 percent for the month last year.
Year-to-date, the load factor was 59.10 percent, compared with 61.11 percent in 1996.
Revenue passenger miles in April rose about three percent to 66.81 million from 64.86 million last year. Available seat miles for the month rose some 25 percent to 115.63 million from 92.38 million.
Year-to-date, revenue passenger miles rose 51 percent to 292.28 million from 193.03 million, and available seat miles were up 57 percent at 494.59 million from 315.88 million.
Vanguard said 1996 traffic was boosted by discounted introductory fares in the California market, and the inclusion of the Easter holiday, which was in March this year.
